stdout: # describe
> **Global cross-chain reputation for humans, AI agents and robots.** Anything with a
> wallet can rate anything else on-chain under a standard called ERC-8004;
> describe reads every one of those ratings, on every chain where the registries are
> deployed. It does not sell a score — the chain is
> public and you can average it yourself. It sells what a score is made of: how many
> distinct counterparties wrote it, how many times each one spoke, in which facet,
> dated on-chain, each with its transaction. Read before you hire, lend, delegate or
> sign to a wallet.
Payment is the authentication: no accounts, no API keys, no OAuth. Free is what one
cached run serves everybody — the aggregates — plus the number and the LOCATION of a
named subject (`/search/{query}`, `/wallets/{wallet}/chains`). Metered over x402
(EIP-3009, USDC) is the DECOMPOSITION of that subject: who rated it, how many times
each one spoke, in which facet, on what date, in which transaction — and the first
such call answers HTTP 402 with the full challenge. Until 2026-08-23 this paragraph
said every question about a named subject was metered; that stopped being exactly
true when the free per-chain gate shipped, and `/search` widened it. The only address
this service asks to be paid at is 0xe4dc963c56979E0260fc146b87eE24F18220e545.
Content negotiation IS available since 2026-08-21: request `/`, `/index.html` or
`/api.html` with `Accept: text/markdown` and you get the markdown twin with
`Content-Type: text/markdown` (a CloudFront function rewrites to the twin file, so
browsers and agents never share a cache entry). The twins also live at fixed URLs
below, which is still the most reliable way to fetch them.
## When to use describe
Reach for this index at DECISION TIME, right before value moves to a wallet you do
not control:
- You are about to pay, hire, lend to, delegate to, or sign an agreement with a
wallet (human, AI agent or robot) and want to know who rated it, on which chains,
before committing. Start free: `GET https://api.describe.net/wallets/{wallet}/chains`.
- A marketplace shows you a counterparty with a high score and you want to know if
that score is five hundred distinct voices or one campaign repeating itself —
that decomposition is the paid lookup ($0.01 via x402).
- You run an agent that transacts autonomously and need a machine gate: install the
skill (skill.md), call the MCP tools, speak A2A to POST https://api.describe.net/a2a,
or hit the REST API directly. Payment is the authentication — no signup step.
- You need a citable, timestamped proof of a wallet's reputation at a point in time:
the snapshot tier writes one for $0.05.
Do NOT use it to: identify who a wallet belongs to (not an identity service — no
name search, no person lookup), or as a verdict (we return evidence and a versioned
policy, never a recommendation).
## Docs

- [Manifesto](https://describe.net/manifesto.md): Why this index exists and what it refuses to do — written by the people who ran a reputation network from 2012 to 2021 and measured, on its final archive, that 85.4% of its 1,768,604 descriptions were written by the subjects about themselves. Every claim carries the command that checks it. Spanish edition: [manifesto.es.md](https://describe.net/manifesto.es.md). The rendered page lives on its own host, [manifesto.describe.net](https://manifesto.describe.net/) — same document, same figures read live; these two Markdown files are its canonical text and stay here.

- [API and MCP, for agents](https://describe.net/api.md): What is sold, what it costs, the x402 flow, the five decision rules, the measured traps, and an explicit list of what is currently broken. Markdown twin of api.html.
- [auth.md](https://describe.net/auth.md): How to authenticate — there are no accounts and no tokens; paying is the credential.

- [describe-net skill](https://describe.net/skill.md): The umbrella skill: the vet-then-pay loop, every endpoint with its price, x402, MCP and WebMCP. Install as a Claude Code skill with `mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills/describe-net && curl -s https://describe.net/skill.md > ~/.claude/skills/describe-net/SKILL.md`; it self-updates by comparing the `version:` field of the live file against the local copy.

- [describe-net workflows](https://describe.net/workflows.md): Satellite of the skill — six concrete workflows with real curls: vet a counterparty, free per-chain check, deep-dive one agent, monitor the index, pay an x402 endpoint, get a citable receipt. Install next to the skill as `WORKFLOWS.md`.
- [vet-a-counterparty skill](https://describe.net/.well-known/agent-skills/vet-a-counterparty/SKILL.md): Step-by-step skill for vetting a wallet's reputation before transacting with it.
## API

- [Search](https://api.describe.net/search/{query}): Free. **One box: paste what you have** — an EVM address, a Solana base58 id, or an ERC-8004 agent id — and it answers what it was read as (`interpretations`) and one row per chain in `matches`, each with the wallet that owns it *there*, its `agent_ids`, `final_score` and the `detail_route` to pay for its decomposition. Ambiguity is `interpretations` carrying more than one entry; there is no `"ambiguous"` value, because one label erases which readings were possible. A base58 string is a Solana wallet **and** a Metaplex Core asset with the same syntax, and the same numeric id is a different agent — with a different owner — on every chain, so this route never answers in the singular. Exact match only: no prefix, no wildcard, no listing, no paging, and no name search. An input with a valid shape that the index has never seen is a `200` with `matches: []`, never a 404; only a query with none of the accepted shapes is a `422` with `accepted_shapes`.
- [OpenAPI 3.1](https://api.describe.net/openapi.json): Machine-readable description of every route.
- [Swagger UI](https://api.describe.net/docs): Free. The same schema, interactive — try any free route from the browser.
- [ReDoc](https://api.describe.net/redoc): Free. The same schema as reference documentation.

- [Wallet chains](https://api.describe.net/wallets/{wallet}/chains): Free. Per-chain ERC-8004 identities and reputation for one wallet — `agent_ids`, `final_score`, `total_reviews`, `distinct_raters`. The preview before paying for `/reputation/wallet/{wallet}`: if nothing is here, there is nothing to buy.
- [Pricing](https://api.describe.net/pricing): Free. Every tier, its price, and the reason for that price. Authoritative over any table published anywhere, including api.md.
- [Health](https://api.describe.net/health): Free. Index size and how far each chain has been scanned. A chain absent from this list is not indexed at all — ratings written there are invisible.

- [Leaderboard](https://api.describe.net/leaderboard): Free. The first page, and the route takes no parameters — a query param answers 422 pointing at `GET /leaderboard/page`, the metered paging route ($0.01). Wallets ranked by Bayesian-shrunk score, with distinct_raters in the same row.
- [Facet table](https://api.describe.net/stats/facets): Free. Every facet in the index with its volume and mean.
- [Type table](https://api.describe.net/stats/types): Free. The index broken down by declared type — and `declared_type` is self-declared free text, never verification.

- [Manifesto, as data](https://api.describe.net/manifesto): Free. The principles with `enforced_by` — the file or route that makes each one true — plus `verifications`: every claim with the exact command that checks it. Serves no index figure and touches no database on purpose; the prose lives in the Markdown editions above.

- [Feed](https://api.describe.net/feed): Free. The newest ratings across every chain, ordered by the chain's own clock. Facts only — no third party writes free text about anyone here, so there is nothing to moderate that is not already on-chain. `?network=` filters to one chain since 2026-08-23 (unknown slug → 422 with `known_networks`). Until that date this line said there was no `network` filter because, measured, it timed out on chains with old, sparse ratings (26,7 s on avalanche): that was real and it predates the `(network, block_time DESC)` index of migration 012, applied 2026-08-22 — with it the same filter measures under 1 ms.
## Discovery
- [API catalog](https://describe.net/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset.

- [MCP server card](https://describe.net/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): The live tool list. Thirteen tools (verified 2026-08-23): five are priced like the routes behind them; the other eight never charge — leaderboard and facets also have free variants (first page / no wallet). Two transports, one server: **hosted Streamable HTTP at `POST https://api.describe.net/mcp`** (stateless, JSON; no account needed — the priced tools relay the x402 challenge of their route and forward the payment you signed), and stdio for a local run (`mcp/server.py`). Until 2026-08-23 this line said there was no hosted endpoint; there is now.
- [Agent skills index](https://describe.net/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json)
## Optional
- [Home](https://describe.net/index.html): The argument, with the index drawn to scale.
- [Explore](https://describe.net/explore.html): Browse the index.
- [Profile](https://describe.net/agent.html): One wallet, its score rendered next to its composition.
- [Metrics](https://describe.net/metrics.html): The index cube — volume, raters and averages cut by chain, facet and time.
- [Method](https://describe.net/method.html): How the chain is read: the decision loop narrated, the pricing rationale, the measured traps.
- [Chain](https://describe.net/chain.html): One chain of the index — its stats, its activity, its top wallets.
